title: Automated Generation of Agent Attack Trajectories Using Constrained Sampling

original_idea.body:
# Automated Generation of Agent Attack Trajectories Using Constrained Sampling

**Problem:** METR's red-team generated covert attack trajectories manually. Automated generation of diverse attack trajectories would accelerate red-teaming but no methodology for this exists at small scale.

**Direction:** Use a red-team LLM (e.g., Llama-3-70B) to generate attack trajectory candidates against a simple monitoring system. Apply constrained sampling (constitutional AI-style critique-revise) to produce varied, realistic trajectories. Evaluate trajectory diversity and evasion success.

**Why it matters:** Manual red-teaming is expensive and limited in coverage. Automated trajectory generation could democratize adversarial evaluation of monitoring systems.

**Relevant context:** METR 2026 covert attack trajectory artifacts; red-team automation literature.
